description: Launch the game from the editor and wait until the MCP runtime inside it is connected. Script errors in the game are logged and auto-continued unless pause_on_error=true.

pause_on_error.description: Leave the game paused in the debugger on script errors (default false).

restart.description: Stop a running game first instead of failing.

scene.description: 'main' (default), 'current' (the edited scene), or a res:// scene path.

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the game to connect (default 20000).

name: game_run
title: Run game
